This rice plot is small but important for my household. I managed to get some improved rice seed from the extension worker last season, and I want to use it well. I will apply a small amount of inorganic fertilizer—just what I can afford from selling some groundnuts—because rice responds well to it, and I will also spread manure from our goats to help the soil. The rest of the work my family can manage ourselves; we cannot afford to hire ganyu labor for this plot.
